functions.name: get
functions.description:
Thread-safe accessor for a single configuration value.

Args:
    key (str): The key of the configuration value to retrieve.
    default: The default value to return if the key is not found.

Returns:
    The value associated with the given key, or the default value if the key does not exist.

functions.name: get_all
functions.description:
Thread-safe accessor for the entire configuration.

Returns:
    A dictionary containing all configuration values.

functions.name: play
functions.description:
Play an MP3 or OGG file.

Args:
    file_path: Path to the audio file.
    block: If True, block until playback finishes.

Returns:
    True if playback started successfully, False otherwise.

functions.name: play_async
functions.description:
Play audio asynchronously in a separate thread.

Args:
    file_path: Path to the audio file.
